responseText:
The last time I was at that great big waterwheel, I noticed something. Those accursed Minotaur have their Ramkin minions hard at work clearing the waterways of Noxious Oozes that are flowing out of the inner workings of the mountain - so the wheel keeps working, I gather.

However, the dumb Ramkin are having trouble on account of undead. You heard me right, skeletons and the like. There are more stinking corpses in the calmer waters too, and I think that nasty ooze is why. The Minotaur steer clear of it.

I have a colleague in Kal Torhum, Leilo. He's a sort of specialist in curses and the undead. I think he'd be able to figure out what's going on here - but he'll need something to hold up to the light. So, I'll tell you where to look, and you go see what you can scrape together for him to take a look at, OK?
